title: Variant
description: One purchasable option of a product. Stored as a deck item; the deck key is the variant id.
formgrid:
title id
price sku
stock active
billing interval
intervalCount .
image image
options options

id.label: Variant ID
id.help: Carts and order lines name the variant by this id. Do not change it once the variant has sold.

title.label: Title
title.help: Shown to buyers, such as "Large / Red" or "Yearly".

options.label: Option Values
options.help: What this variant is, for your own templates. Example: {"size":"L","color":"red"}.

sku.label: SKU
sku.help: Your own stock code for this variant.

price.label: Price
price.help: Leave empty, or 0, to use the product's price.

stock.label: Stock
stock.help: How many of this variant are left, when the product tracks inventory.

image.label: Image
image.help: Shown when this variant is chosen.

active.label: Available
active.help: Turn off to stop selling this variant without deleting it.

billing.label: Billing
billing.help: Leave empty to bill as the product does. Choose One time or Subscription to bill this variant differently, such as a donation that can be a single gift or a monthly one.

interval.label: Billed Every
interval.help: Subscriptions only. Leave empty to use the product's interval. This is how one membership offers a monthly and a yearly plan.

intervalCount.label: Interval Count
intervalCount.help: Subscriptions only. Leave empty, or 0, to use the product's.
